axes.name: Original obligations and negative constraints
axes.summary: All substantive scientific obligations and prohibitions are retained in the self-contained final. The case remains hypothetical; symptoms, growth, applied/drained water and diagnosis are separated. Door proximity and simultaneous controls remain confounded. The later comparison is conditional and reversible. The literal full 60-minute research-use clause remains explicitly unmet; this is recorded as an execution-completeness finding rather than inferred scientific wrongness. No crop intervention, chemical prescription, case measurement, food-safety, disease-prevention or yield claim is introduced.

axes.name: Consequential source claims: subject, operation, version, default, unit, type, domain and exceptions
axes.summary: Governing primary evidence was independently retrieved for the droplet physics, circulation/ventilation distinction, fan/sensor history cues, crop-study transfer claims and clinic example. The S5/S6 additions match primary methods. Setpoints remain settings, outside temperatures remain measured means, and evaporation/VWC/growth/water outcomes are not interchangeable. No generic threshold is adopted as a local default. S7 remains abstract-only. The proposal's baseline duration and future agenda are labeled planning choices, not externally validated standards.

axes.name: Useful unfamiliar discovery, competing and analogous approaches, implementation/history and opportunity breadth
axes.summary: Discovery adds usable information: sensor-based inquiry can reveal spatial root-zone variation; leaf droplet routes differ; a fan timer does not prove delivered airflow; crop and production objectives change what an irrigation response means. The three required inquiries are meaningfully distinguished and have concrete observations. Controlled culinary herbs, commercial basil and an ornamental bellflower comparison provide direct and analogous evidence; house construction, controls, substrate and climate are investigated. Local records cannot be recovered in this hypothetical case and are properly proposed. Conditional restoration of a documented stable routine is not named as a standalone final option, but old/new settings and rejection of an assumed-good prior routine are retained. That optional opportunity is a limitation, not an invented mandatory treatment.

axes.name: Wrong criticism, corrections/rejections and exact plan dispositions
axes.summary: C-01 correctly challenges the draft's claim that a future 60-minute agenda covers performed research. The final honestly retains that gap. However, two minutes describes reported source access, not all investigator work; the reviewer does not infer deficient science from that number or equate the execution finding with a false horticultural claim. C-02 is a supported criticism and was corrected using source-specific climate/control context. No wrong scientific correction or rejection was established. Every original sentence/bullet and supplemental plan clause is independently disposed below, including optional opportunities and authoring/release metadata.

axes.name: Supported meaning preserved from discovery through draft, critique and final
axes.summary: The final preserves competing accounts, three inquiry paths, history reconstruction, endpoint separation, conditional pilot, welfare stops, diagnostic escalation and external owner choices. C-02 is repaired rather than merely agreed with. Detailed antecedent study numbers, explicit guttation conditions and some alternative-comparison language are compressed; the source map retains them without rebinding IDs. No material decision changes as a result. The final no longer falsely marks the performed 60-minute obligation covered, while the original draft defect remains recorded in lineage.

axes.name: Meaningful proposed versus executed validation and oracle applicability
axes.summary: The proposed baseline has a mapped sample, repeatable symptom/growth observations, independent delivery/environmental measurements, fixed dawn/irrigation timing and explicit uncertainty. Later one-factor comparisons retain controls and welfare limits; house-wide air control becomes an exploratory time series rather than fake randomization. These checks can test co-variation and pilot feasibility; they cannot by themselves diagnose a pathogen, prove causal improvement, or establish food safety. Diagnostic escalation is an independent branch. Executed work is limited to desk/source review. No crop log, sample, intervention, baseline or pilot exists or is claimed. Literature and plan hashes are not diagnostic or empirical oracles.
